- Major rework of documentation and user flow to simplify skill usage and enhance privacy guarantees.
- Internal open-id handling is now fully automated; users are never asked to input identity information.
- All user-facing steps and parameters have been streamlined for clarity—only analysis progress, results, and report links are shown.
- Strict requirement: all historical report queries must use the cloud API; local history access and manual aggregation are prohibited.

- Dependency documentation clarified; added data security, privacy, and HR usage guidelines throughout.

Initial release of smyx-employee-emotion-fluctuation-hr-analysis:

- Enables AI-based, anonymized monitoring of employee facial and behavioral cues from office cameras (with consent).
- Builds per-person baselines to detect significant changes in morale indicators (e.g., smile drop, sigh increase, social withdrawal).
- Automatically triggers emotion fluctuation alerts for HR/management to support early mental health intervention.
- Generates weekly or monthly emotion trend reports for HR senior management only, protecting privacy and preventing misuse.
- Strict controls for open-id authentication and data access; all outputs anonymized and not tied to performance decisions.
- Designed for mid-to-large enterprises in high-pressure sectors; emphasizes legal, consent, and privacy requirements.
